items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Beautiful musicians, they were around my age, you know. And they'd meet me (wherever) meet me in East St. Louis.

ctx.x: Charlie Creath. He could have gotten me for free, really and truly, you know. So, my family just got this horn for me and I put a little money on it so I told Mr. Langford. (7...) wrapped in this tissue and all that kind of mess. And it was a corn horn, you know, CGM ... Joseph L. Thomas and, man I looked at that horn and all the things happening on the horn and beautiful. I told my me buddy I'm working with Charlie Creath, a new horn and working with Charlie Creath. You working with Charlie Creath. Now what do…
